name: spell-check
author: lumine-code
description: Highlight misspelled words and offer contextual corrections.
backgroundTips: You can open spelling corrections for the word under the cursor with {{ 'spell-check:correct-misspelling' | keystroke }}
You can temporarily disable checking in the current editor with the spell-check toggle command.

grammars.title: Checked Grammars
grammars.description: Root scopes or detailed scope selectors that should be checked.

excludedScopes.title: Excluded Scopes
excludedScopes.description: Detailed scope selectors ignored inside checked grammars.

useSystem.title: Use System Dictionaries
useSystem.description: Use the operating system spelling service when supported.

useLocales.title: Use Locale Dictionaries
useLocales.description: Load Hunspell dictionaries for the configured locales.

locales.title: Locales
locales.description: Locale identifiers such as en-US or pl-PL; an empty list uses the detected default.

localePaths.title: Dictionary Search Paths
localePaths.description: Additional directories and path specifications containing Hunspell dictionaries.

knownWords.title: Known Words
knownWords.description: Words treated as correct; prefix an entry with ! to make it case-sensitive.

addKnownWords.title: Offer Known Word Actions
addKnownWords.description: Include an action that adds the selected word to Known Words.

noticesMode.title: Dictionary Notices
noticesMode.description: Choose where dictionary loading messages are displayed.

enableDebug.title: Debug Logging
enableDebug.description: Write detailed checker diagnostics to the developer console.
